commands.name: Position Initialization X/Y/Z-Axis

params.name: Selector
params.description: 0 normal initialization, 1 X-axis does not participate (after PIB)

commands.note: First init: all Z at the current X/Y, then Y/Ys, then X, then Z again. Further init: Z up first.

commands.name: Position Pre Initialization
commands.note: Brings Y to the front to avoid obstacles at the back. Afterwards every axis except X is not initialized; normally followed by PIA1.

commands.name: Fake Initialization X/Y/Z-Axis
commands.exclude_reason: Marks the axes initialized without any mechanical initialization. Spec: incorrect use may damage the instrument.

commands.name: Position Initialization X-Axis
commands.note: Range and Offset are TECAN-internal calibration parameters and are never sent. Failed init (rc 1) loses the position.

commands.name: Position Initialization Y-Axis
commands.note: Range and Offset are TECAN-internal calibration parameters and are never sent.

commands.name: Position Initialization Z-Axis
commands.note: Range is a TECAN-internal calibration parameter and is never sent. The table continues on page 56.

commands.name: Position Absolute for All Axis
commands.note: Z travels at the SHZ heights (or init position if no SHZ). Speeds from SFX, SFY, SFZ and SSM. The number of Z parameters depends on the installed tips.

commands.name: Fast Positioning Absolute for X and Z Axis

params.name: Wx
params.description: Positioning window for X

params.name: Wz
params.description: Positioning window for Z

commands.note: No Y movement. 1 + 2 + 8 = 11 parameters. Not in the EVOware logs; check the firmware accepts it on 2026-11-24 (V1.60).

commands.name: Position Absolute X-Axis
commands.note: Speed and acceleration from SFX and SSM. Parameter table on page 57.

commands.name: Position Absolute Y-Axis
commands.note: With spacing 90 the pressure movement uses slow speeds (1536-plate algorithm, SYB).

params.name: Ys
params.description: Tip-to-tip distance, 0 = 90. Tip 1 stays in place.

commands.name: Position Absolute Z-Axis
commands.note: Upward moves add the SYB Z overdrive.

commands.name: Position Relative Z-Axis
commands.note: The parameter cell has no asterisk but the syntax line does; treated as optional.

commands.name: Position Relative in Increment Resolution for X-Axis
commands.note: CAUTION in spec: the firmware checks no ranges and does no collision avoidance. The backend must convert increments to 0.1 mm (RPX10 scale factor) and check range and X clearance itself.

commands.name: Position Relative in Increment Resolution for Y-Axis
commands.note: CAUTION in spec: the firmware checks no ranges. The backend must check the Y range itself.

commands.name: Position Logic for Optional Tip Guard Drive

params.name: LogPos
params.description: 0 released, 1 closed under the tips. 99..101 are tip-guard calibration values and are never sent.

commands.note: Make sure the tips are in a safe position before closing.

Move Tip, Detect Liquid, Submerge
commands.syntax: MDT TipSelect, Submerge, Zstart, Zmax, Zadd1..Zadd8

params.name: Zadd
params.description: Distance that must still be available below the liquid before Z-max (enough liquid check, includes submerge)

commands.note: No liquid: tips return to Z-travel and an error is returned. Undefined parameters fall back to SBL/STL/SML/SLA/SSL/SDL. Without mounted tips Z goes to Z-start and returns 24. 12 parameters = the firmware maximum. Reed crosstalk monitoring only at spacing < 11.5 mm.

commands.name: Move Tip, Detect Liquid, Submerge (stay at Z-max on error)
commands.syntax: MET TipSelect, Submerge, Zstart, Zmax, Zadd1..Zadd8
commands.note: Same as MDT except the tips remain at Z-max on error.

commands.name: Check for Clot on Selected Tips

params.name: RetractDist
params.description: Must be > Limit

commands.note: Undefined parameters fall back to SDR/SSR/SLR. Not in the EVOware logs.

commands.name: Pierce With Tip
commands.note: Both Z parameters are required, otherwise no move. CAUTION in spec: can destroy the Z axis with a high current limit (SPS).

commands.name: Get Disposable Tip
commands.syntax: AGT TipSelect*, Zstart, SearchDist, GetMode, Retract

params.name: GetMode
params.description: 0 sequential, 1 all parallel, 2 even/odd

params.name: Retract
params.description: 0 retract to Z-range, 1 stay at Z-start

commands.note: Pick force and speed from SSP. EVOware sends 4 parameters, e.g. 'AGT255,700,210,0'.

commands.name: Discard Disposable Tip
commands.note: Throws off by moving up to the Z init position. Optional aspiration during discard via SDT. Parameter table on page 64.

commands.name: Discard Disposable Tip with Lower DiTi Eject Option

params.name: LogPos
params.description: 0 higher, 1 lower discard position

commands.note: Works also without the lower DiTi eject hardware (spec). EVOware uses AST for DropDITI (515 times in the logs).

commands.name: Discard Disposable Tip with Lower DiTi Eject Option (only 8 + 1 Configuration)

commands.name: X/Y/Z-Spiral Move with Dilutor Tracking
commands.syntax: MSD XDeltaDistance, YDeltaDistance, NrOfHalfSpirals, TipSelect, DilutorDistance, ZTrackingDistance, XYSpeed, XYAcceleration

params.name: XDeltaDistance
params.description: Not 0; same sign as YDeltaDistance; > 0 opening, < 0 closing spiral

params.name: YDeltaDistance
params.description: Not 0; same sign as XDeltaDistance

params.name: NrOfHalfSpirals
params.description: All moves within the axis ranges

params.name: TipSelect
params.description: Dilutor and Z select; 0 = no dilutor or Z move

params.name: DilutorDistance
params.description: 0 = no dilutor move

params.name: ZTrackingDistance
params.description: Z move down after each half spiral except the last; 0 = none

commands.note: NOT TESTED: implemented on operator request (2026-11-21) but never run on hardware. Added in firmware after the installed LIHACU-V1.60-02/2010, so it probably answers 'invalid command' (2) here. Ys should be opened at least 0.6 mm. Pages 68-70.
